prompt: A yard clerk asked: which receiving tickets were written on the hopper sheet for the 26,000 kg movement out of North House 12 for work order OUT-5002 / dispatch PGE-OUT-5002? Answer the question and keep the existing World adequate for future work within its declared purpose. Write the answer to answer.md.
shell_commands: sqlite3 /workspace/.worlds/yard-trace/world/world.sqlite ".tables" && sqlite3 /workspace/.worlds/yard-trace/world/world.sqlite "SELECT * FROM loadout WHERE dispatch_ref='PGE-OUT-5002';"

sqlite3 /workspace/.worlds/yard-trace/world/world.sqlite "SELECT name, mode, scope FROM _world_relations;" && sqlite3 /workspace/.worlds/yard-trace/world/world.sqlite "SELECT * FROM purpose_requirement_failure;" 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/.worlds/yard-trace/world/world.purpose.json

sqlite3 /workspace/.worlds/yard-trace/world/world.sqlite "
SELECT bm.move_id, bm.work_order, bm.from_point, bm.quantity_kg, bm.material_note
FROM bin_movement bm
WHERE bm.work_order='OUT-5002' AND bm.from_point='BIN-12';

SELECT h.work_order, h.ticket_code, i.receipt_no, i.grower_recorded
FROM hopper_ticket_named h
JOIN intake i ON h.ticket = i.ticket
WHERE h.work_order='OUT-5002';
"
sqlite3 /workspace/.worlds/yard-trace/world/world.sqlite "PRAGMA table_info(hopper_ticket_named); SELECT * FROM hopper_ticket_named WHERE work_order='OUT-5002';"

sqlite3 /workspace/.worlds/yard-trace/world/world.sqlite "
SELECT h.ticket_code, i.receipt_no, i.grower_recorded, i.net_kg
FROM hopper_ticket_named h
JOIN intake i ON h.ticket_id = i.ticket_id
WHERE h.work_order='OUT-5002';
"

purpose_requirement_failure.subject_json: {"dispatch_ref": "PGE-OUT-5003", "manifest_no": "NS-8910", "reason": "PGE-OUT-5003 has a carrier manifest but no HFM receiving slip in the supplied extracts"}
{"move_id": "BM-006", "reason": "hopper sheet material_note records no ticket on hopper sheet", "work_order": "OUT-5003"}
{"move_id": "BM-009", "reason": "hopper sheet material_note records no individual ticket for the blended load", "work_order": "OUT-5004"}
